proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: checks conditions (1) and (2) of the fibred-groupoids definition: (1) pullback of the polarization L' is ample by the ample-base-change lemma, giving a lift; (2) the lift of a morphism over the base is unique, given explicitly by chi = psi o (k^* phi)^{-1}; composition of fibred functors is fibred by the categories lemma, giving fibration over Sch_fppf (fibre groupoid check referenced to the cited categories lemma) (source lines 4042-4081)
